To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a thermal model that is able to accurately predict the temperature evolution of large prismatic battery.
a coupled thermal and heat source model is proposed for the characterization of a prismatic Li-ion cell.
we have proposed a lumped thermal model of LiFePO 4 battery which is coupled with a heat generation model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the thermal and heat generation modeling of a prismatic Li-ion cell and its characterization.
the development of a thermal model of a large prism battery.
the thermal and electrical modeling of large prisms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a thermal model is a powerful tool for the characterization of a battery.
the proposed thermal modeling approach is a very good compromise between simplicity and accuracy.
the proposed models are able to predict the battery temperature and its heat generation with a precision of about 1 °C and 10 W, respectively.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the coupled thermal and the heat generation models can accurately predict the temperature variation in the battery and can be used for the thermal simulation of large Li-ion battery.
we developed a new method for determining the electrical parameters as function of state-of-charge, current and temperature.
the coupled models can predict the battery temperature and the heat generation during the characterization with a precision of ±1 °C.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the thermal modeling of large prisms is possible and the proposed models are accurate enough to be used for thermal simulation.

the heat generation model is essential in the characterization of large Li-ion batteries and that it is possible to determine the electrical parameters as function of the SoC, current and temperature.
it is possible to accurately model the heat generation and the heat transfer in LiFePO 4 batteries.
